name: Scott Nodder
category: Marine GIS and scientific mapping practitioners
story: Dr Scott Nodder of NIWA co-authored the June 2008 Water & Atmosphere account of Chatham Rise and Challenger Plateau mapping under Ocean Survey 20/20. The article documented multibeam acoustic surveys, seafloor sampling design and the integration of geographic data with biological observations.

The publication identifies Nodder as a marine geologist in Wellington and credits the programme's broader multi-agency research team. The particular multibeam GIS datasets were collaborative outputs, not individual authorship claims.
